claims.citation: New York Herald, 11 September 1866, p. 8, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Hermann (Brem), Wenke, Bremen Aug 26, via
Southampton 29th, at 5 PM, with mdse and 767 passengers,
to Oelrichs & Co. Had strong westerly gales on the pass-
age. Aug 29, off the Needles, passed steamship New York,
hence for Bremen; 2d inst, lat 51, lon 29, ship Transit, bound
W; 6th, lat 45, lon 52, a National Company's steamer, bound
E; 7th, lat 43, lon 60 30, steamship Persia, hence for Liver-
pool; same day, steamship Palmyra, bound E; 9th, 7:30 AM,
220 miles E of Sandy Hook, steamships Allemania, America,
and City of New York, bound E.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 13 September 1866, p. 8, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Scotland (Br) Hall, Liverpool, Aug 29, and
Queenstown 30th, with mdse and 647 passengers, to National
Steam Navigation Co. Sept 7, lat 46 29, lon 48 48, spoke ship
Thomas Rowell, bound W; 10th, 3:30 AM, lat 42 44, lon 6[?]
17, saw steamship City of New York, hence for Liverpool;
also ship S P Southard, bound E; same day, 1 PM, lat 41[?] 44,
lon 63 17, passed steamship Pennsylvania, hence for Liver-
pool.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 18 September 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Palmyra (Br), Watson, Liverpool, Sept 4, and
Queenstown 5th, with mdse and 448 passengers, to E
Cunard. Sept 4, 5:35 PM, passed ship S Curling, from St
John, NB, bound in; 9th, lat 50 6 N, lon 30 32 W, passed
ship Java, bound W; 12th, lat 47 38, lon 56, passed steamship
City of New York, hence for Liverpool; 16th, lat 42 40, lon
65[?] 13, passed ship Ellen Austin, from Liverpool for New
York.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted lat. 42 44, long. 63 17 (Sept. 10 3:30 a. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Scotland (Br.), Hall, Liverpool, Aug. 29 and Queens-
town 30th, with mdse. and 647 pass. to the National Steam Navigation
Company. Sept. 7, lat. 46 29, long. 48 48, spoke ship Thomas Powell
bound W; Sept. 10, 3:30 a. m., lat. 42 44, long. 63 17, saw steamship
City of New-York bound E; also, ship S. P. Southward bound E;
same day, 1 p. m., lat. 42 44, long. 63 17, passed steamship Pennsylva-
nia bound E.
